thread:
rachel: Following PM-2910 I'm collecting owners for the follow-ups so we have runnable tests and clear timelines. Main goals: reproducible prompt set, a bounded load smoke that surfaces the tail, and a small chaos drill to exercise fallback routing.

diego: I can take the smoke load job. Plan: stage-only job that runs a 10m steady burst at 600 qps with a short ramp. Success criteria: p95 < 380ms and error-rate < 0.8%. I'll open INF-4401.

sam: I'll own the prompt corpus. I'll assemble ~150 prompts pulled from incident traces and tag each as "latency-check" or "semantic-check". Will provide a CSV with validator hints (regex/prefix/length). Ticket INF-4402.

mira: Great. Sam, for latency-check prompts avoid strict token asserts; use coarse checks. For semantic ones include a sample expected prefix or a short matcher.

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4401 by diego 9: "stage smoke load: 600qps steady, p95 guardrail"

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4402 by sam 9: "incident prompt corpus: 150 samples with validators"

rachel: I'll take the chaos drill runbook and the fallback harness integration. We need a small runner that can flip a routing tier and simulate 20% KV cache pod restarts during the run. Ticket INF-4403. ETA ~12 days.

diego: For the load job I'll put a sample wrk command in the ticket and a tiny lua that picks long-sequence payloads. Example snippet in repro steps.

sam: For the CSV I'll include a source column (s3 path or incident id) so reviewers can trace prompts back to real data. Also will mark a subset as "core-regression" (25 prompts) that need to run in CI against pinned models.

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4403 by rachel 9: "chaos drill: fallback + kv-restart simulation"

mira: Please link INF-4401/4402/4403 back to PM-2910 and add a short "repro steps" block and artifacts. The gating rule for review: ticket must include a runnable script, sample data, and monitoring hooks.

rachel: noted. I'll add a runbook section with steps for pre-checks, safe rollback, and a dashboard tile to monitor p95, error-rate, and kv-miss%.

diego: Timeline in INF-4401: prototype job in 4 days, stage job in 8 days, smoke run + baseline capture in 11 days.

sam: INF-4402 draft CSV ready in 3 days. I'll also add validator examples and a small test harness that returns pass/fail.

mira: Also want an "owner sign-off" action in next ops sync. Whoever owns the ticket should present a short demo.

ops-bot: Linked INF-4401 -> PM-2910; INF-4402 -> PM-2910; INF-4403 -> PM-2910

rachel: I'll wire a basic dashboard tile under Console/tests/incident-regressions and attach the dashboard JSON to INF-4403.

diego: putting load script PR up after lunch, ping me for review.

sam: uploading CSV now. PR link in INF-4402.

mira: Thanks all. We'll check progress in the ops sync in two weeks; if any ticket slips beyond ETA add a comment with blocker. Also schedule the first mini-drill for three weeks out so we can exercise the flow.

rachel: scheduling the drill and adding calendar invites to the tickets. :calendar:
